entries.title: Job 32:1
segments: ¶So these three men ceased answering Job, because he [was] righteous in his own eyes.

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: Then the wrath of Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was aroused against Job; his wrath was aroused because he justified himself rather than God.

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: Also against his three friends his wrath was aroused, because they had found no answer, and [yet] had condemned Job.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: Now because they [were] years older than he, Elihu had waited to speak to Job.

entries.title: Job 32:5
segments: When Elihu saw that [there was] no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was aroused.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: ¶So Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, answered and said: "I [am] young in years, and you [are] very old; Therefore I was afraid, And dared not declare my opinion to you.

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: I said, 'Age should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.'

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: But [there is] a spirit in man, And the breath of the Almighty gives him understanding.

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: Great men are not [always] wise, Nor do the aged [always] understand justice.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments: "Therefore I say, 'Listen to me, I also will declare my opinion.'

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments: Indeed I waited for your words, I listened to your reasonings, while you searched out what to say.

entries.title: Job 32:12
segments: I paid close attention to you; And surely not one of you convinced Job, [Or] answered his words-

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: Lest you say, 'We have found wisdom'; God will vanquish him, not man.

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: Now he has not directed [his] words against me; So I will not answer him with your words.

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: ¶"They are dismayed and answer no more; Words escape them.

entries.title: Job 32:16
segments: And I have waited, because they did not speak, Because they stood still [and] answered no more.

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments: I also will answer my part, I too will declare my opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments: For I am full of words; The spirit within me compels me.

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: Indeed my belly [is] like wine [that] has no vent; It is ready to burst like new wineskins.

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: I will speak, that I may find relief; I must open my lips and answer.

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: Let me not, I pray, show partiality to anyone; Nor let me flatter any man.

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: For I do not know how to flatter, [Else] my Maker would soon take me away.
